import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 31;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] m;
        int size;

        Matrix(int n) {
            size = n;
            m = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    m[i][j] = 0;
                }
                m[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix mul(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        sum += this.m[i][k] * b.m[k][j];
                        sum %= MOD;
                    }
                    res.m[i][j] = sum;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        Matrix[][] M = new Matrix[71][k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            M[0][i] = new Matrix(k + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                M[0][i].m[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        long[] powArr = new long[100];
        powArr[0] = 1;
        powArr[1] = k;
        int level = 2;
        while (powArr[level - 1] <= n / k) {
            powArr[level] = powArr[level - 1] * k;
            level++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < level; i++) {
            M[i][0] = new Matrix(k + 1);
            for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
                M[i][j] = M[i - 1][j - 1].mul(M[i][j - 1]);
            }
            Matrix prod = new Matrix(k + 1);
            for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                prod = prod.mul(M[i - 1][j]);
                M[i][j] = M[i][j].mul(prod);
            }
        }

        Matrix answer = new Matrix(k + 1);
        int c = 0;
        for (int i = level - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (powArr[i] <= n) {
                n -= powArr[i];
                answer = M[i][c].mul(answer);
                c++;
                c %= k;
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            total += answer.m[i][k];
            total %= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
